correctness.rationale: Using the column environment generator Q=[[-a,b],[a,-b]], diagonal K, stationary state weights p=(b,a)/(a+b), the second moments u solve (2K-Q)u=2Dp. C(t)=1^T exp((Q-K)t)u and R(t)=1^T exp((Q-K)t)p. Stationarity gives F(0)=k^Tu-D=0, while exact matrix algebra gives F’(0)=Dab(k1-k0)^2/[(a+b)Z]. The two distinct positive decay rates lambda± of -(Q-K) have spectral gap Delta and product Y, uniquely yielding F(t)=F’(0)/Delta [exp(-lambda_-t)-exp(-lambda_+t)]. For k1!=k0 this is strictly positive and has exactly one maximum at log(lambda_+/lambda_-)/Delta; its area is F’(0)/Y. At k0=0, Z=Y=bk1 cancels k1 exactly. Independently verified stationary moment identities, the two-mode derivative, area and boundary with rational/symbolic matrix checks; finite numeric tests do not replace eigenvalue proof.
